name: markswift

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/cli.ts src/index.ts src/compiler/index.ts --target=node --packages=external --splitting --outdir dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: bun test tests/unit tests/architecture tests/integration tests/conformance playground/tests
scripts.test:native: MARKSWIFT_SWIFT_TESTS=1 bun test tests/integration/swift.test.ts tests/unit/swift/wrapping.test.ts tests/unit/swift/tracks.test.ts tests/unit/swift/counter.test.ts tests/integration/generated-content.test.ts tests/unit/swift/flex-row.test.ts tests/unit/swift/measured-layout.test.ts tests/unit/swift/line-height.test.ts tests/unit/swift/tooltips.test.ts tests/unit/swift/bands.test.ts tests/unit/swift/bands-emit.test.ts tests/conformance/pilot-run.test.ts tests/integration/perf.test.ts

description: Measured HTML and CSS to native SwiftUI components
